description: Use this whenever the user asks about decision models or LLMs for classification, routing, triage or yes/no calls. Accuracy on our decision test (routing tickets, applying rules, spotting phishing, flagging risky code changes), how well each model's confidence matches its accuracy (calibration), and API cost per 1,000 calls. Covers dedicated decision models and regular LLMs given the same tasks.

type.description: decision = dedicated decision models only (default), llm = regular LLMs only.

name: decision_models
title: Decision model rankings
